newsitem.title: FRANCE: Club Med nine-month turnover falls.
newsitem.headline: Club Med nine-month turnover falls.

text.p: (All figures in millions of French francs)
NOTE - Club Mediterranee issued its nine-month sales in a statement.
It said the drop was due principally to the sale of Maeva, which represented turnover of 311 million francs last year.

It said that, on a like-for-like basis and at constant exchange rates, turnover was down 2.1 percent in the first nine months from the year-earlier period, compared with a three percent decline for the first six month from a year earlier. It said the improvement was due in part to the rapid growth of the Club Aquarius activities.
